keyword: Kawasaki hydraulic pump on the concrete pump order

title.en: Write a Kawasaki Model Only When That Xingtai Page Prints It
title.zh: 只有邢台那一页印了川崎型号，订单才写

description.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai prints Kawasaki 112, Kawasaki 140 or a double-pump line on some sheets only. Electric 15, Electric 20 and Electric 50 do not get a borrowed name.
description.zh: 河北品锦机械在邢台只在部分表上印川崎 112、川崎 140 或双泵一行。电动15、电动20和电动50不能借用这个名称。

h1.en: The Hydraulic-Pump Name Is a Cell, Not a Family Rule
h1.zh: 液压泵名称是一格，不是全系列规则

directAnswer.en: On Hebei Pinjin Machinery’s Xingtai sheets, copy a hydraulic-pump name only from the page you order. Electric 40, Electric Low Pressure 40 and Diesel 40 print Kawasaki 112. Diesel 120 prints Kawasaki 112 as two units. Diesel 50 and Electric 80 print Kawasaki 140, and Electric 80 adds “double pump”. Diesel 60 prints Kawasaki double pump 100. Electric 20, Electric 15, Electric 50 and the rural diesel list used here do not print that name. An order for those pages leaves the name off. Price is still inquiry-only at [/en/contact/](/en/contact/).
directAnswer.zh: 在河北品锦机械（邢台）的表上，只从你订的那一页抄液压泵名称。电动40、电动低压40和柴油40印川崎 112。柴油120把川崎 112 印成两台。柴油50和电动80印川崎 140，电动80还写了“双泵”。柴油60印川崎双泵 100。此处使用的电动20、电动15、电动50和农村柴油泵列表不印这个名称。那些页面的订单不要写上名称。价格仍然只在 [/zh/contact/](/zh/contact/) 询盘。

heading.en: Double pump is not one phrase

body.en: Electric 80 says Kawasaki 140 double pump. Diesel 60 says Kawasaki double pump 100. The numbers are different cells.
body.zh: 电动80写川崎 140 双泵。柴油60写川崎双泵 100。数字是不同的格子。

body.en: Write two units when the page says two units. A single Kawasaki 112 is the Diesel 40 line.
body.zh: 页面写两台时就写两台。单台川崎 112 是柴油40的行。

body.en: If you need the factory to name a pump that the sheet omits, ask as a question. Do not fill the cell yourself.
body.zh: 如果需要工厂点明表上没有的泵，请作为问题提出。不要自己填格。

answer.en: Not on the list used here.
answer.zh: 此处使用的列表上没有。
它印的是川崎 140 双泵。

question.en: Is the brand name a price?
Who can add a missing name?
question.zh: 谁可以补上缺失的名称？

answer.en: Xingtai, if you ask. The public cell stays as printed until then.
answer.zh: 如果你询问，由邢台回复。在此之前公开格子保持原样。
